Text.Text: The unauthorized test cell is shut down. Put that fire-control training to better use. You've finished my Killzone Beacon trials. I have no further work for you here.
Briefing access requires rank 50 in Devices. Reach that rank, then report back for the bunker assignment.

An engineering cell has repurposed bunker fire-control hardware for unauthorized live testing. Recover their docket and report back. Defeat six Killzone Beacon Adepts in Viscara, Republic Engineering Bunker. Their defeat secures the Killzone Beacon Republic Bunker Docket; bring it back to me here in Viscara, Republic Base, Entrance. I'll give you the Viscara Republic Engineering Bunker Key when you accept. Complete all five trials to earn the right to train Killzone Beacon.

Here's the Viscara Republic Engineering Bunker Key. Use 'Republic Engineering Bunker' in Viscara, Republic Base, Combat Deck. My key grants access. Keep your party close to the entrance when you use it so they can enter with you. Defeat six Killzone Beacon Adepts, then return with the Killzone Beacon Republic Bunker Docket.

It marks a kill zone before the enemy occupies it, so fire converges the instant they do. Effective doctrine in the right hands. In the wrong hands it paints friendly positions just as easily, which is why it cannot leak.
That docket is the Republic's own filing on bunker fire-control assets. If it's in that cell's hands, someone with clearance handed it to them, and I need a name before I need a court-martial.
Six adepts, standard live-fire discipline, nothing you haven't handled. Treat every marker in that bunker as active. This is not a drill and I will not pretend it is one to make you comfortable.

Defeat six Killzone Beacon Adepts in Viscara, Republic Engineering Bunker. Their defeat secures the Killzone Beacon Republic Bunker Docket; bring it back to me here in Viscara, Republic Base, Entrance.
You've defeated six Killzone Beacon Adepts. Let me see the Killzone Beacon Republic Bunker Docket.
Record recovered. We can trace the orders now. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the specialist trial when you're ready.

The specialists are using the shield grid to support those tests. Recover their relay. Defeat five Killzone Beacon Specialists in Viscara, Republic Engineering Bunker. Their defeat secures the Killzone Beacon Shield Grid Relay; bring it back to me here in Viscara, Republic Base, Entrance.
Your key still grants access to Viscara, Republic Engineering Bunker. Defeat five Killzone Beacon Specialists to secure the Killzone Beacon Shield Grid Relay, then return to me.
It keeps broadcasting kill-zone geometry to whoever's listening. Eventually that's every hostile force on Viscara with a receiver. I want it silent before that happens.
Shield grids and targeting grids share the same backbone in bunker installations. Whoever repurposed it knew that. That's not a lucky guess, that's someone with Republic training.

Yes. I recommend two companions for the Killzone Beacon Specialist fight. That's advice for a dangerous encounter, not an entry requirement. Gather your party before calling the challenge; a second pair of hands can keep a bad opening from ending the fight.

Defeat five Killzone Beacon Specialists in Viscara, Republic Engineering Bunker. Their defeat secures the Killzone Beacon Shield Grid Relay; bring it back to me here in Viscara, Republic Base, Entrance.
You've defeated five Killzone Beacon Specialists. Let me see the Killzone Beacon Shield Grid Relay.
Equipment recovered. Their training operation is disrupted. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the warden trial when you're ready.

The warden protects the cell's command hardware. Recover the command crest and end his watch. Defeat the Killzone Beacon Warden in Viscara, Republic Engineering Bunker. Their defeat secures the Killzone Beacon Cracked Command Crest; bring it back to me here in Viscara, Republic Base, Entrance. I recommend bringing two companions for this fight.

In Viscara, Republic Engineering Bunker, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Killzone Beacon Warden. Accept this assignment before using the marker. Bring two companions if you can. After the fight, return with the Killzone Beacon Cracked Command Crest.

Yes. I recommend two companions for the Killzone Beacon Warden fight. That's advice for a dangerous encounter, not an entry requirement. Gather your party before calling the challenge; a second pair of hands can keep a bad opening from ending the fight.
Cracked like that, under load, which means he's been running live command scenarios longer than any bunker range should allow. I want to know exactly how long.

Textbook, which is what makes him dangerous. He's not improvising. He's running Republic tactics against Republic-trained targets, which means he's had exactly the kind of teacher I'm afraid he's had.

Defeat the Killzone Beacon Warden in Viscara, Republic Engineering Bunker. Their defeat secures the Killzone Beacon Cracked Command Crest; bring it back to me here in Viscara, Republic Base, Entrance. Use the '???' challenge marker there to begin the fight. Two companions are recommended.
You've defeated the Killzone Beacon Warden. Let me see the Killzone Beacon Cracked Command Crest.
Warden defeated. That breaks their enforcement. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the inner circle trial when you're ready.

Four quartermasters still authorize the cell's supplies. Take their override chip. Defeat four members of the Killzone Beacon Inner Circle in Viscara, Republic Engineering Bunker. Their defeat secures the Killzone Beacon Quartermaster Override Chip; bring it back to me here in Viscara, Republic Base, Entrance.

Your key still grants access to Viscara, Republic Engineering Bunker. Defeat four members of the Killzone Beacon Inner Circle to secure the Killzone Beacon Quartermaster Override Chip, then return to me.
Every requisition override, timestamped, cross-referenced against a quartermaster's signature. It's the paper trail that turns a rogue cell into a court-martial.
Someone with enough rank to move bunker hardware without a second signature. That's a short list. I've narrowed it further than I'm comfortable admitting.
Recommended. Four hostiles is worse odds than one warden in some respects. Keep your fire team intact; I don't reissue clearances for replacements mid-briefing.

Defeat four members of the Killzone Beacon Inner Circle in Viscara, Republic Engineering Bunker. Their defeat secures the Killzone Beacon Quartermaster Override Chip; bring it back to me here in Viscara, Republic Base, Entrance.
You've defeated four members of the Killzone Beacon Inner Circle. Let me see the Killzone Beacon Quartermaster Override Chip.
Their officers no longer control the authorizations. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the final trial when you're ready.

The master controls the firing doctrine behind the tests. Defeat him in the Engineering Command Room. Defeat the Killzone Beacon Master in Viscara, Engineering Command Room. Report back to me here in Viscara, Republic Base, Entrance; no item is needed for this final trial. I recommend bringing two companions for this fight.

In Viscara, Engineering Command Room, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Killzone Beacon Master. Accept this assignment before using the marker. Bring two companions if you can. Once the master is defeated, come back for the final lesson.
Command's own staging ground, if his projections hold. He's not testing anymore. He's rehearsing a strike against people who trust that ground is safe.
In Viscara, Engineering Command Room, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Killzone Beacon Master. Accept this assignment before using the marker.

Then the doctrine gets reissued, correctly, to someone who reads a grid reference and sees people worth protecting, not targets worth painting. That would be you, assuming this goes the way I need it to.

Defeat the Killzone Beacon Master in Viscara, Engineering Command Room. Report back to me here in Viscara, Republic Base, Entrance; no item is needed for this final trial. Use the '???' challenge marker there to begin the fight. Two companions are recommended.
You've defeated the Killzone Beacon Master. Give me your report and we'll finish the trial.
The unauthorized test cell is shut down. Put that fire-control training to better use. You've earned the right to train Killzone Beacon. Your final payment is ready.
Back to the briefing.
I'll defeat six Killzone Beacon Adepts.
What does a killzone beacon actually do?
Why does this docket matter to the Republic?
What's the risk profile on site?
Not cleared for this yet. Standing by.
Here's the Killzone Beacon Republic Bunker Docket.
Back to the briefing.
I'll defeat five Killzone Beacon Specialists.
What happens if that relay stays active?
Why is a shield grid relay tied to targeting?
Would you recommend bringing help?
Requesting delay before deployment.
Here's the Killzone Beacon Shield Grid Relay.
Back to the briefing.
I'll defeat the Killzone Beacon Warden.
Would you recommend bringing help?
What does the crest tell you?
What's the warden's command style?
Requesting time to assemble a team.
Here's the Killzone Beacon Cracked Command Crest.
Back to the briefing.
I'll defeat four members of the Killzone Beacon Inner Circle.
What's on a quartermaster override chip?
Who signs off on requisitions like this?
Should I deploy with the same team?
Requesting a briefing delay.
Here's the Killzone Beacon Quartermaster Override Chip.
Back to the briefing.
I'll face the Killzone Beacon Master and report back.
What position is he planning to paint?
Where did he learn this doctrine?
What happens to the doctrine after this?
Requesting more time before final deployment.
The Killzone Beacon Master is defeated. Here's my report.
